name: the drop sends a taken name before asking
Replace overwrites whatever the name holds
Replace expects the live version, not the one shown
replace:
ELSE IF n \notin ns THEN expect[n]
                 ELSE IF a = "replace" THEN shown[n]

ELSE IF n \notin ns THEN expect[n]
                 ELSE IF a = "replace" THEN (IF disk[n] \in Files THEN disk[n] ELSE shown[n])

name: a name a folder took is dropped without asking
replace: THEN /\ item' = [item EXCEPT ![n] = IF disk[n] \in Files THEN "asking" ELSE "skipped"]

name: Replace shows over a folder
replace: \cup (IF n \notin Folders /\ shown[n] \in Files THEN {"replace"} ELSE {})

name: a refused Replace whose file is gone is dropped
replace:
ELSE /\ expect' = [expect EXCEPT ![n] = "none"]
            /\ item' = [item EXCEPT ![n] = "skipped"]
            /\ UNCHANGED shown

name: the drop sends a taken folder at once
cancelling a folder leaves what it holds waiting
